supreme.title: You Are the New CEO
supreme.text: The founder is gone. The board has voted. Your name is on the door of the top office. Your rivals smile, or they are working somewhere else. The power is yours now. So is every plot that will be made to take it from you.

shadow_regent.title: The Power Behind the New CEO
shadow_regent.text: The young CEO smiles for the cameras and reads the speeches you wrote. Your name is on no door, but no big decision happens without it. It is the safest kind of power: the kind nobody sees.

overthrown.title: Voted Out by the Board
overthrown.epitaph: Every rival you made came to the same meeting.
text: They did not need a fight. The rivals you made, one insult at a time, finally compared notes. By midnight the board had changed sides. By morning your office had a new owner.
Your orders went unanswered and your meeting invites were declined. Your team looked at their screens. Your power drained away until a polite email could remove you. Nobody even had to be your enemy.

abandoned.title: Your Team Walked Away
abandoned.epitaph: The room emptied slowly, then all at once.
abandoned.text: Nobody shouted. They just stopped coming. The replies, the favours, the lunch invitations all faded. One by one, your people found better teams to join. The company did not turn on you. It simply forgot you.

bankrupt.title: Out of Budget, Out of Power
bankrupt.epitaph: Power runs on budget, pay and favours.
text: Oliver's lawyers arrived with a folder and a very polite smile. Your debts were the only thing you owned. The company was kind enough to call it a restructure.
Without a budget, orders stopped working and favours stopped coming back. Within a quarter, nobody remembered if you had ever been dangerous. You were just broke.

exposed_manipulator.title: Caught as a Schemer
exposed_manipulator.epitaph: Every message led back to you.
exposed_manipulator.text: Someone finally laid all the pieces side by side. The whispers, the lucky accidents, the friends who were so useful. A company forgives mistakes more easily than cleverness. HR walked you out with a box.

disgraced.title: Reputation Ruined
disgraced.epitaph: Talk stopped when you came in. Then you stopped coming in.
disgraced.text: Nobody could say exactly what you had done. In the end it did not matter. A name that nobody says out loud is a closed door, and a company is made of doors.

feared_isolated.title: Feared and Alone
feared_isolated.text: Your word is law, and nobody argues, even when you are wrong. The team nods so hard that you cannot see their faces. Somewhere in the chat, a few of them have started a private channel.

eclipsed.title: Pushed Aside by the CEO
eclipsed.epitaph: A person who is bigger than the boss does not last long.
eclipsed.text: Your grip on the company grew until the CEO could feel it on his own neck. The order, when it came, was polite. A new title in a far-away office, and a proper handover plan to make sure you went.

gilded_cage.title: The Golden Title
gilded_cage.epitaph: Loved by all, and kept safe from view.
gilded_cage.text: Everyone loves you. They write posts about you. The board finds you so loved that every move you make is a danger to someone. So they give you a grand title, a quiet role and a very long stay in your own good name.

puppet.title: Smothered by Yes-People
puppet.text: Your team guesses your every wish. They solve problems before you hear of them and shield you from anyone who disagrees. Somewhere in all this comfort, you stopped deciding. A leader whose people love him too much to say no is only a name on a chart.

plundered.title: Too Big a Budget to Be Safe
plundered.text: Your budget became all anyone talked about. New audits were found that no one had mentioned. Old debts came back. A very official order to cut your funds arrived with all the right signatures, and it took everything.

negotiated_exit.title: You Leave on Your Own Terms
negotiated_exit.epitaph: You left while they still said please.
negotiated_exit.text: A fine package, a long holiday and a warm goodbye. You leave with your name safe and a long list of people who wish you had stayed. A longer list is relieved that you did not. Few people rise so high and choose when to step down.

exiled_alive.title: Laid Off, But Standing
exiled_alive.epitaph: Walking out on your own feet is a kind of win.
exiled_alive.text: You bargained for your future in a glass meeting room and won it. A severance, a reference and a promise to stay quiet. It is not what you came for. But it is more than most who lose to a group of rivals ever keep.

poisoned.title: The Report You Signed
poisoned.epitaph: Someone was always going to try.
poisoned.text: The numbers looked perfect. You were not the first to be handed that report, and you did not look closely at who gave it to you. The audit came too late. The company moved on with great speed.

legacy_architect.title: Your Legacy: The Quiet Builder
legacy_architect.text: You leave a healthy budget, honest books and a name that opens doors when you are not in the room. The company history will give you a small note. That is just how the best builders like it.

legacy_beloved.title: Your Legacy: The Loved Manager
legacy_beloved.epitaph: They would have followed you anywhere.
legacy_beloved.text: People remember how it felt to work for you. Those you lifted up kept your name alive. Those you spared made sure the stories got kinder each time they were told. Not every career needs a big title.

legacy_iron.title: Your Legacy: The Iron Fist
legacy_iron.epitaph: Orders were obeyed. Not everyone has forgiven them.
legacy_iron.text: You ran the company like a machine you were afraid to stop. It worked. Targets were hit and rebels were beaten. People still lower their voices when your name is said. The numbers call it success. Your rivals call it a long winter.

legacy_quiet.title: Your Legacy: The Quiet Winner
legacy_quiet.epitaph: You wanted one thing and you got it.
legacy_quiet.text: You did not run the company. You wanted one thing, in silence, and now you have it. The people who could have stopped you did not notice until it was done.

legacy_survivor.title: Your Legacy: The Survivor
legacy_survivor.epitaph: You are still here. That counts.
legacy_survivor.text: You outlasted the CEO's moods, the board's questions and your own mistakes. Few can say the same. You are not loved or hated. In a big company, that is the closest thing to safety.
